name: Prafulla Chandra Ray
contribution: Prafulla Chandra Ray was a pioneering chemist, teacher, and industrialist who founded Bengal Chemical and Pharmaceutical Works and promoted scientific education.
context: Scientific education, indigenous industry, and intellectual life in late-colonial Bengal.
impact: His work connected laboratory science with industrial development and public arguments for locally rooted scientific enterprise.
highlight: Prafulla Chandra Ray combined chemistry, teaching, and industrial entrepreneurship in Bengal.
